title: Uncertainty Evaluation: Bridging Machine Learning and Measurement Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.18066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable uncertainty evaluation is essential for assessing the trustworthiness of machine learning (ML) predictions, particularly in safety-critical applications. This paper explores conceptual analogies between uncertainty evaluation in ML and measurement science, drawing on the evolution of metrology from error-based approaches to the framework established by the Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement (GUM). Particular attention is devoted to the distinction between process-level and result-level quality and to the limitations of the conventional classification of ML uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components. It is argued that this dichotomy, similarly to the traditional distinction between random and systematic measurement errors, is inherently model-dependent and provides an insufficient basis for a unified uncertainty evaluation framework. translated_title: 不确定性评估：连接机器学习与测量科学
translated_abstract: 可靠的不确定性评估对于衡量机器学习（ML）预测的可信度至关重要，尤其是在安全关键应用中。本文探讨了机器学习中的不确定性评估与测量科学之间的概念类比，借鉴了计量学从基于误差的方法到《测量不确定度表示指南》（GUM）所确立框架的演变历程。本文特别关注了过程级质量与结果级质量之间的区别，以及将机器学习不确定性传统上划分为偶然不确定性与认知不确定性两类做法的局限性。本文认为，这种二分法（类似于随机误差与系统测量误差的传统区分）本质上是依赖于模型的，无法为统一的不确定性评估框架提供充分的基础。此外，本文还进一步类比了机器学习与测量领域……
tldr: 本文通过将机器学习的不确定性评估与测量科学（计量学GUM框架）进行概念类比，指出传统的偶然/认知不确定性二分法本质上是依赖模型的，不足以支撑统一的不确定性评估框架。
en_tdlr: This paper draws conceptual analogies between uncertainty evaluation in machine learning and measurement science (the GUM framework in metrology), arguing that the conventional aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty dichotomy is inherently model-dependent and insufficient as a basis for a unified uncertainty evaluation framework.
